content:
Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. is a specialized chemical enterprise located in the Lantian Industrial Zone of Yongzhong Town, Longwan District, Wenzhou, China. Benefiting from the region’s well-developed industrial infrastructure, convenient transportation network, and supportive business environment, the company has cultivated a strong foundation for steady growth and reliable supply to customers at home and abroad.

Since its establishment, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. has focused on the research, production, and sale of chemical products used across coatings, plastics, adhesives, textiles, and related industrial fields. Emphasizing both quality and consistency, the company follows standardized production processes and implements strict quality control systems to ensure that its products meet applicable industry standards and customer-specific requirements. Over the years, it has built up a reputation for stable quality, competitive pricing, and timely delivery.

Longchang places strong importance on safety and environmental responsibility. The company works to optimize its production technology, reduce emissions and waste, and comply with relevant environmental regulations and safety norms. At the same time, it continually updates its equipment and processes to improve efficiency and product performance.

With a customer-oriented philosophy, Wenzhou Longchang Chemical Co., Ltd. aims to establish long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships. By combining practical industry experience, technical know‑how, and a responsive service team, the company strives to offer reliable chemical solutions and support the sustainable development of its clients in various downstream sectors.
